correctness.rationale: On W={0<1}, persistence forces R_1={(v,w):R(1,v,w)} to be an upper set of the 2x2 square, with R_1 empty implying R_0 empty, and R_0 union R_1 an upper set. There are six upper sets, with admissible count 1+10+12+12+16+16=67. Independently enumerated all 256 ternary relation masks, filtering both persistence clauses verbatim; truth sets are empty,{1},W, and existential/universal modalities were computed on 3^2 pairs and tested all 27 associativity triples plus 16 quadruples for relational associativity. Exactly 32 relations were relationally and jointly modal associative, 11 jointly modal associative but not relational, 24 only existential associative. No additional outcomes; witness relation bitmasks 160 (existential only) and 173 (both modalities but relation nonassociative) independently checked. One-world/trivially ordered two-world bases cannot exhibit separation by Boolean complement duality, so two-chain is minimal. Bounded census is exhaustively complete for 2^8 candidates but makes no all-frame assertion.
